blocks.text: With their singles campaigns behind them, Alexandra Eala and Zeynep Sonmez turned their attention to the women’s doubles tournament and fought to extend their stay at the Wuhan Open. But the Ukrainian pair of Dayana Yastremska, 26, and Anhelina Kalinina, 29, dashed their hopes with a straight sets win over the younger and less experienced pair, 6-2, 6-3. Kalinina and Yastremska will next face doubles specialists Shuai Zhang and Anna Danilina, the second-seeded pair in Wuhan.
